items.summaryZh: 预览：西太平洋银行（ Westpac ）认为，新西兰储备银行（ RBNZ ）明天将OCR提高至2.75% ，相关数据取决于财政部官员：片山， Bessent会谈涵盖外汇干预，日本财政政策FINMIN片山和Bessent确认需要有序的日元走势中国私人PMI超过预测，是五年来最长的回升。澳元支持。

items.title: investingLive Americas FX news wrap 31 Aug: The USD moves lower. USD corrects after Warsh's hawkish speech at Jackson Hole
items.summary: US broader indices close lower on the day. Nasdaq 100 closes marginally higher Trump to announce new drug pricing agreement. Strategic Petroleum Reserves fell by 3.1M barrels to 286.6M barrels. Who is to blame? Buyers in crude oil had their shot to take price higher from a technical perspective and they missed. European shares close closely lower.
items.summaryZh: 美国大盘指数当日收盘走低。纳斯达克100指数(Nasdaq 100)收盘价略高于特朗普，以宣布新药定价协议。战略石油储量下降310万桶至2.866亿桶。谁是罪魁祸首？原油买家有机会从技术角度提高价格，但他们错过了。欧洲股票收盘价接近下跌。
